# Protected areas from the WDPA

```{r wdpa}
wdpa_url <- paste0("https://data-gis.unep-wcmc.org/server/rest/services/ProtectedSites/",
                   "The_World_Database_of_Protected_Areas/FeatureServer/1/query")

wdpa_page <- function(offset, page = 500L) {
  req <- httr2::request(wdpa_url) |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      where             = "1=1",
      geometry          = sprintf("%f,%f,%f,%f", dom_bb["xmin"], dom_bb["ymin"],
                                  dom_bb["xmax"], dom_bb["ymax"]),
      geometryType      = "esriGeometryEnvelope",
      inSR              = "4326",
      spatialRel        = "esriSpatialRelIntersects",
      outFields         = "*",
      returnGeometry    = "true",
      outSR             = "4326",
      resultOffset      = offset,
      resultRecordCount = page,
      f                 = "geojson"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(600)
  txt <- httr2::resp_body_string(httr2::req_perform(req))
  f <- file.path(tempdir(), sprintf("wdpa_%d.geojson", offset))
  writeLines(txt, f)
  out <- try(sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  unlink(f)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  out
}

wdpa_path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "wdpa_domain.gpkg")
if (!file.exists(wdpa_path)) {
  acc <- list(); off <- 0L; page <- 500L
  repeat {
    p <- wdpa_page(off, page)
    if (is.null(p) || nrow(p) == 0) break
    acc[[length(acc) + 1L]] <- p[, intersect(names(p), c("WDPAID", "NAME", "DESIG_ENG",
                                                         "IUCN_CAT", "STATUS", "STATUS_YR",
                                                         "ISO3", "MARINE")), drop = FALSE]
    msg("WDPA page at offset ", off, ": ", nrow(p), " features")
    if (nrow(p) < page) break
    off <- off + page
    if (off > 20000L) break
  }
  if (!length(acc)) stop("WDPA query returned nothing. Check network access to ",
                         "data-gis.unep-wcmc.org, or download the COG and COD ",
                         "country packages from protectedplanet.net and merge them ",
                         "into ", wdpa_path)
  pa <- do.call(rbind, acc) |> sf::st_make_valid() |> sf::st_transform(4326)
  pa <- pa[!sf::st_is_empty(pa), , drop = FALSE]
  pa <- sf::st_filter(pa, sf::st_sf(geometry = domain_union))
  sf::write_sf(pa, wdpa_path, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  rm(acc); gc()
}
pa <- sf::st_read(wdpa_path, quiet = TRUE)
msg("Protected areas intersecting the domain: ", nrow(pa))
```

# Roads, rivers and settlements from OpenStreetMap

The Geofabrik archives are large. The spatial filter is pushed into GDAL at
read time so a national road layer is never fully loaded, only the columns
needed are kept, and the clipped subsets are cached in `data/processed/` for
later runs.

```{r osm}
geofabrik <- c(COG = "congo-brazzaville", COD = "congo-democratic-republic")

osm_cache <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir,
                       c(roads_all = "roads_all.gpkg", roads_major = "roads_major.gpkg",
                         places_pop = "places_pop.gpkg", rivers = "rivers.gpkg"))
names(osm_cache) <- c("roads_all", "roads_major", "places_pop", "rivers")

osm_buffer_deg <- 0.5
bbv <- unname(as.numeric(dom_bb[c("xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax")])) +
  c(-osm_buffer_deg, -osm_buffer_deg, osm_buffer_deg, osm_buffer_deg)
dom_box <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(
  c(xmin = bbv[1], ymin = bbv[2], xmax = bbv[3], ymax = bbv[4]), crs = 4326))
dom_box_wkt <- sf::st_as_text(dom_box)

major_classes <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary",
                   "motorway_link", "trunk_link", "primary_link",
                   "secondary_link", "tertiary_link")

if (all(file.exists(osm_cache[c("roads_all", "places_pop", "rivers")]))) {

  msg("reusing cached OpenStreetMap subsets from ", cfg$proc_dir)
  roads_all   <- sf::st_read(osm_cache[["roads_all"]],   quiet = TRUE)
  roads_major <- if (file.exists(osm_cache[["roads_major"]]))
    sf::st_read(osm_cache[["roads_major"]], quiet = TRUE) else NULL
  places_pop  <- sf::st_read(osm_cache[["places_pop"]],  quiet = TRUE)
  rivers      <- sf::st_read(osm_cache[["rivers"]],      quiet = TRUE)

} else {

  osm_layers <- list()
  for (iso in iso_list) {
    slug <- geofabrik[[iso]]
    zipf <- file.path(cfg$raw_dir, sprintf("%s-latest-free.shp.zip", slug))
    outd <- file.path(cfg$raw_dir, sprintf("osm_%s", iso))
    dir.create(outd, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (!length(list.files(outd, pattern = "gis_osm_roads_free_1\\.shp$",
                           recursive = TRUE))) {
      msg("downloading the Geofabrik extract for ", iso)
      ok <- try(download_resumable(
        sprintf("https://download.geofabrik.de/africa/%s-latest-free.shp.zip", slug),
        zipf, rounds = 30, min_bytes = 1e6), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(ok, "try-error")) {
        stop("Could not download the Geofabrik extract for ", iso, ". ",
             "Fetch it manually with: wget -c ",
             sprintf("https://download.geofabrik.de/africa/%s-latest-free.shp.zip", slug),
             " and place it at ", zipf)
      }
      if (!is_zip_file(zipf)) stop("Geofabrik download is not a ZIP: ", zipf)
      msg("unpacking ", basename(zipf))
      utils::unzip(zipf, exdir = outd, overwrite = TRUE)
    }
    osm_layers[[iso]] <- outd
  }

  # Read only the required columns, only inside the domain box.
  read_osm <- function(pattern, keep_cols, label) {
    parts <- lapply(names(osm_layers), function(iso) {
      f <- list.files(osm_layers[[iso]], pattern = pattern,
                      full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
      if (!length(f)) return(NULL)
      msg("reading ", label, " for ", iso)
      x <- try(sf::st_read(f[1], quiet = TRUE, wkt_filter = dom_box_wkt),
               silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(x, "try-error")) {
        msg("  wkt_filter not supported by the driver; reading in full")
        x <- sf::st_read(f[1], quiet = TRUE)
      }
      if (nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
      keep <- intersect(keep_cols, names(x))
      x <- x[, keep]
      x$iso3 <- iso
      x
    })
    parts <- parts[!vapply(parts, is.null, logical(1))]
    if (!length(parts)) return(NULL)
    keep <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(parts, names))
    out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(parts, function(z) z[, keep]))
    rm(parts); gc()
    sf::st_transform(out, 4326)
  }

  roads_all <- read_osm("gis_osm_roads_free_1\\.shp$", c("fclass"), "roads")
  places    <- read_osm("gis_osm_places_free_1\\.shp$", c("fclass"), "places")
  waters    <- read_osm("gis_osm_waterways_free_1\\.shp$", c("fclass"), "waterways")

  clip_to_domain <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(NULL)
    out <- sf::st_filter(x, dom_box)
    if (nrow(out) == 0) NULL else out
  }

  roads_all   <- clip_to_domain(roads_all)
  roads_major <- if (is.null(roads_all)) NULL else
    roads_all[roads_all$fclass %in% major_classes, ]
  places_pop  <- clip_to_domain(places)
  places_pop  <- if (is.null(places_pop)) NULL else
    places_pop[places_pop$fclass %in% c("city", "town", "village", "hamlet"), ]
  rivers      <- clip_to_domain(waters)
  rivers      <- if (is.null(rivers)) NULL else
    rivers[rivers$fclass %in% c("river", "canal"), ]
  rm(places, waters); gc()

  for (nm in c("roads_all", "roads_major", "places_pop", "rivers")) {
    x <- get(nm)
    if (!is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0)
      sf::write_sf(x, osm_cache[[nm]], delete_dsn = TRUE)
  }
}

# An empty layer would silently turn a distance covariate into all NA and drop
# every cell from the model, so fail here with something readable.
for (nm in c("roads_all", "places_pop", "rivers")) {
  x <- get(nm)
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    stop("OpenStreetMap layer '", nm, "' is empty over the study domain. ",
         "Check that the Geofabrik archives unpacked into ", cfg$raw_dir)
  }
}
for (nm in c("roads_all", "roads_major", "places_pop", "rivers")) {
  x <- get(nm)
  msg(nm, ": ", if (is.null(x)) 0 else nrow(x), " features")
}
gc()
```

# Rainfall from CHIRPS

Monthly Africa rasters are small once cropped to the domain, so they are
accumulated into a single numeric matrix rather than a list of 300 SpatRaster
objects, each of which would otherwise leave a temporary file behind.

```{r chirps}
if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps)) {
chirps_dir <- file.path(cfg$raw_dir, "chirps")
dir.create(chirps_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

chirps_stack_path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "chirps_monthly_domain.tif")

if (!validate_geotiff(chirps_stack_path)) {

  chirps_url <- function(y, m) {
    sprintf(paste0("https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS-2.0/",
                   "africa_monthly/tifs/chirps-v2.0.%04d.%02d.tif.gz"), y, m)
  }
  chirps_file <- function(y, m) {
    file.path(chirps_dir, sprintf("chirps-v2.0.%04d.%02d.tif.gz", y, m))
  }

  read_chirps_month <- function(y, m) {
    dst <- chirps_file(y, m)
    got <- try(download_file_safe(chirps_url(y, m), dst, tries = 2,
                                  min_bytes = 1e5), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(got, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    r <- try(terra::rast(paste0("/vsigzip/", normalizePath(dst))), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(r, "try-error")) { unlink(dst); return(NULL) }
    rc <- try(terra::crop(r, dom_ext, snap = "out"), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(rc, "try-error")) return(NULL)
    rc
  }

  # Establish the template from the first month that is available.
  tmpl <- NULL
  for (y in cfg$chirps_years) {
    for (m in 1:12) {
      tmpl <- read_chirps_month(y, m)
      if (!is.null(tmpl)) break
    }
    if (!is.null(tmpl)) break
  }
  if (is.null(tmpl)) stop("No CHIRPS month could be downloaded. Check network ",
                          "access to data.chc.ucsb.edu, or set cfg$use_chirps ",
                          "to FALSE.")
  chirps_tmpl <- terra::rast(tmpl)   # geometry only
  ncell_c <- terra::ncell(chirps_tmpl)
  msg("CHIRPS domain window: ", terra::nrow(chirps_tmpl), " x ",
      terra::ncol(chirps_tmpl), " cells")

  n_slot <- 12L * length(cfg$chirps_years)
  vals <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncell_c, ncol = n_slot)
  lyr_names <- character(n_slot)
  k <- 0L

  for (y in cfg$chirps_years) {
    for (m in 1:12) {
      rc <- read_chirps_month(y, m)
      if (is.null(rc)) { msg("CHIRPS month unavailable, skipping: ", y, "-", m); next }
      if (!terra::compareGeom(rc, chirps_tmpl, stopOnError = FALSE, messages = FALSE)) {
        rc <- terra::resample(rc, chirps_tmpl, method = "bilinear")
      }
      v <- terra::values(rc)[, 1]
      v[v < -100] <- NA_real_
      k <- k + 1L
      vals[, k] <- v
      lyr_names[k] <- sprintf("p_%04d_%02d", y, m)
      rm(rc, v)
    }
    msg("CHIRPS year ", y, " done (", k, " layers so far)")
  }
  if (k == 0L) stop("No CHIRPS layers were assembled.")

  chirps_out <- terra::rast(chirps_tmpl, nlyrs = k)
  terra::values(chirps_out) <- vals[, seq_len(k), drop = FALSE]
  names(chirps_out) <- lyr_names[seq_len(k)]
  terra::writeRaster(chirps_out, chirps_stack_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  rm(vals, chirps_out, tmpl, chirps_tmpl); sweep_temp()
}
chirps <- terra::rast(chirps_stack_path)
msg("CHIRPS stack: ", terra::nlyr(chirps), " monthly layers")
} else {
  chirps <- NULL
  msg("CHIRPS disabled by configuration.")
}
```

# Baseline forest and peat masks

Both masks are used in every counting pass, so each is built once with a
single streaming operation and stored as a one-byte compressed GeoTIFF.

```{r base-masks}
agg_fact <- as.integer(round(cfg$grid_deg / terra::res(lossyear)[1]))
stopifnot(agg_fact >= 2)
msg("Aggregation factor: ", agg_fact, " (cell size ", cfg$grid_deg, " deg)")

forest_path  <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "forest2000_30m.tif")
peatbin_path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "peat_binary_30m.tif")

.fthresh  <- cfg$forest_thresh
.fclasses <- cfg$forest_classes
.pclass   <- cfg$peat_class

if (!cached_ok(forest_path, ref = lossyear, nlyr = 1, label = "forest2000_30m.tif")) {
  msg("building the baseline forest mask")
  if (have_treecover) {
    terra::lapp(c(treecover, peat30),
                fun = function(tc, pc) {
                  as.integer(!is.na(tc) & !is.na(pc) &
                               tc >= .fthresh & pc %in% .fclasses)
                },
                filename = forest_path, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_int)
  } else {
    terra::lapp(peat30,
                fun = function(pc) as.integer(!is.na(pc) & pc %in% .fclasses),
                filename = forest_path, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_int)
  }
  sweep_temp()
}
forest30 <- terra::rast(forest_path); names(forest30) <- "forest2000"

if (!cached_ok(peatbin_path, ref = lossyear, nlyr = 1, label = "peat_binary_30m.tif")) {
  msg("building the peat swamp forest mask")
  terra::lapp(peat30,
              fun = function(pc) as.integer(!is.na(pc) & pc == .pclass),
              filename = peatbin_path, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_int)
  sweep_temp()
}
peat_bin30 <- terra::rast(peatbin_path); names(peat_bin30) <- "peat"

y_lo_rec <- cfg$recent_window[1] - 2000L
y_hi_rec <- cfg$recent_window[2] - 2000L
n_years  <- as.integer(cfg$year_max - 2000L)
```

# Streaming count engine

This replaces the whole-raster terra passes of V5. One pass over the 30 m
grid produces every count the analysis needs: baseline forest, peat, peat
forest, the annual loss and fire counts for each year from 2001 to
`r cfg$year_max`, and the non-fire counts for each analysis window. Peak
memory is a slab of `r cfg$block_rows_target` raster rows across four layers.

```{r block-engine}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# count_blockwise()
#
# Reads lossyear, fireyear, the forest mask and the peat mask in horizontal
# slabs and tabulates counts directly into small accumulator arrays. Values
# are identical to terra::aggregate(fun = "sum") on the same masks; this is
# checked against terra in the verification chunk below.
#
# Returns a list of matrices with dim (grid rows, grid cols) and arrays with
# dim (grid rows, grid cols, years).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

count_blockwise <- function(fact,
                            r_loss = lossyear, r_fire = fireyear,
                            r_forest = forest30, r_peat = peat_bin30,
                            label = "grid counts", quiet = FALSE) {

  nr <- terra::nrow(r_loss); nc <- terra::ncol(r_loss)
  nyr <- n_years

  ngr <- as.integer(ceiling(nr / fact))
  ngc <- as.integer(ceiling(nc / fact))
  gcol <- ((seq_len(nc) - 1L) %/% fact) + 1L

  # Slab height must divide the aggregation factor so a slab never straddles
  # two grid rows.
  divs   <- seq_len(fact)[fact %% seq_len(fact) == 0L]
  target <- max(1L, min(fact, cfg$block_rows_target))
  rpc    <- max(divs[divs <= target])

  win <- list(
    rec  = c(cfg$recent_window[1] - 2000L, cfg$recent_window[2] - 2000L),
    base = c(cfg$base_window[1]   - 2000L, cfg$base_window[2]   - 2000L),
    all  = c(1L, nyr)
  )

  base_forest <- matrix(0, ngr, ngc)
  base_peat   <- matrix(0, ngr, ngc)
  base_pf     <- matrix(0, ngr, ngc)
  ann_loss <- array(0, c(ngr, ngc, nyr))
  ann_fire <- array(0, c(ngr, ngc, nyr))
  ann_lp   <- array(0, c(ngr, ngc, nyr))
  ann_fp   <- array(0, c(ngr, ngc, nyr))
  nonfire  <- lapply(win, function(z) matrix(0, ngr, ngc))

  terra::readStart(r_loss); terra::readStart(r_fire)
  terra::readStart(r_forest); terra::readStart(r_peat)
  on.exit({
    try(terra::readStop(r_loss), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(r_fire), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(r_forest), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(r_peat), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  gv_cache <- list()
  t0 <- Sys.time()

  for (b in seq_len(ngr)) {
    r_start <- (b - 1L) * fact + 1L
    r_end   <- min(b * fact, nr)
    rr <- r_start

    acc_forest <- numeric(ngc); acc_peat <- numeric(ngc); acc_pf <- numeric(ngc)
    acc_loss <- matrix(0, ngc, nyr); acc_fire <- matrix(0, ngc, nyr)
    acc_lp   <- matrix(0, ngc, nyr); acc_fp   <- matrix(0, ngc, nyr)
    acc_nf   <- lapply(win, function(z) numeric(ngc))

    while (rr <= r_end) {
      nsub <- min(rpc, r_end - rr + 1L)
      key <- as.character(nsub)
      if (is.null(gv_cache[[key]])) gv_cache[[key]] <- rep.int(gcol, nsub)
      gv <- gv_cache[[key]]

      Lv <- terra::readValues(r_loss,   row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
      Fv <- terra::readValues(r_fire,   row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
      Ov <- terra::readValues(r_forest, row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
      Pv <- terra::readValues(r_peat,   row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)

      # NA outside the domain means "no loss" and "not forest".
      Lv[is.na(Lv)] <- 0; Fv[is.na(Fv)] <- 0
      Ov[is.na(Ov)] <- 0; Pv[is.na(Pv)] <- 0
      Lv <- as.integer(Lv); Fv <- as.integer(Fv)
      fo <- Ov > 0.5; pe <- Pv > 0.5
      rm(Ov, Pv)

      acc_forest <- acc_forest + tabulate(gv[fo], nbins = ngc)
      acc_peat   <- acc_peat   + tabulate(gv[pe], nbins = ngc)
      fp <- fo & pe
      acc_pf     <- acc_pf     + tabulate(gv[fp], nbins = ngc)

      selL <- fo & Lv >= 1L & Lv <= nyr
      if (any(selL)) {
        k <- (Lv[selL] - 1L) * ngc + gv[selL]
        acc_loss <- acc_loss + matrix(tabulate(k, nbins = ngc * nyr), ngc, nyr)
        selLP <- selL & pe
        if (any(selLP)) {
          k <- (Lv[selLP] - 1L) * ngc + gv[selLP]
          acc_lp <- acc_lp + matrix(tabulate(k, nbins = ngc * nyr), ngc, nyr)
        }
      }
      selF <- fo & Fv >= 1L & Fv <= nyr
      if (any(selF)) {
        k <- (Fv[selF] - 1L) * ngc + gv[selF]
        acc_fire <- acc_fire + matrix(tabulate(k, nbins = ngc * nyr), ngc, nyr)
        selFP <- selF & pe
        if (any(selFP)) {
          k <- (Fv[selFP] - 1L) * ngc + gv[selFP]
          acc_fp <- acc_fp + matrix(tabulate(k, nbins = ngc * nyr), ngc, nyr)
        }
      }

      # Non-fire loss is computed explicitly rather than as loss minus fire,
      # so the result does not depend on fire being a strict subset of loss.
      for (w in names(win)) {
        lo <- win[[w]][1]; hi <- win[[w]][2]
        s <- fo & (Lv >= lo & Lv <= hi) & !(Fv >= lo & Fv <= hi)
        if (any(s)) acc_nf[[w]] <- acc_nf[[w]] + tabulate(gv[s], nbins = ngc)
      }

      rm(Lv, Fv, fo, pe, fp, selL, selF)
      rr <- rr + nsub
    }

    base_forest[b, ] <- acc_forest
    base_peat[b, ]   <- acc_peat
    base_pf[b, ]     <- acc_pf
    ann_loss[b, , ]  <- acc_loss
    ann_fire[b, , ]  <- acc_fire
    ann_lp[b, , ]    <- acc_lp
    ann_fp[b, , ]    <- acc_fp
    for (w in names(win)) nonfire[[w]][b, ] <- acc_nf[[w]]

    if (!quiet && (b %% 10L == 0L || b == ngr)) {
      el <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))
      msg(sprintf("%s: grid row %d of %d (%.1f min elapsed, about %.1f min left)",
                  label, b, ngr, el, el / b * (ngr - b)))
    }
  }

  sum_years <- function(A, lo, hi) {
    idx <- seq.int(max(1L, lo), min(nyr, hi))
    if (length(idx) == 1L) A[, , idx] else apply(A[, , idx, drop = FALSE], c(1, 2), sum)
  }

  out <- list(
    fact = fact, ngr = ngr, ngc = ngc, nyr = nyr,
    n_forest = base_forest, n_peat = base_peat, n_peat_forest = base_pf,
    ann_loss = ann_loss, ann_fire = ann_fire,
    ann_loss_peat = ann_lp, ann_fire_peat = ann_fp
  )
  for (w in names(win)) {
    lo <- win[[w]][1]; hi <- win[[w]][2]
    out[[paste0("n_loss_", w)]]      <- sum_years(ann_loss, lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_fire_", w)]]      <- sum_years(ann_fire, lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_loss_peat_", w)]] <- sum_years(ann_lp,   lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_fire_peat_", w)]] <- sum_years(ann_fp,   lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_nonfire_", w)]]   <- nonfire[[w]]
  }
  out
}

# Turn an accumulator matrix into a SpatRaster on the aggregated grid.
grid_extent_for <- function(fact, ref = lossyear) {
  ngr <- ceiling(terra::nrow(ref) / fact)
  ngc <- ceiling(terra::ncol(ref) / fact)
  rx  <- terra::xres(ref); ry <- terra::yres(ref)
  terra::ext(terra::xmin(ref), terra::xmin(ref) + ngc * fact * rx,
             terra::ymax(ref) - ngr * fact * ry, terra::ymax(ref))
}

mat_to_grid <- function(M, fact, ref = lossyear) {
  r <- terra::rast(nrows = nrow(M), ncols = ncol(M),
                   extent = grid_extent_for(fact, ref), crs = terra::crs(ref))
  terra::values(r) <- as.vector(t(M))
  r
}
```

```{r block-engine-verification}
# Run both engines on an aligned sub-window and require an exact match before
# the block engine is trusted for the full domain.
verify_block_engine <- function(fact = agg_fact) {
  nw <- min(as.integer(cfg$verify_window_cells), 6L)
  nr <- terra::nrow(lossyear); nc <- terra::ncol(lossyear)
  rx <- terra::xres(lossyear); ry <- terra::yres(lossyear)
  ngr <- ceiling(nr / fact); ngc <- ceiling(nc / fact)

  b0 <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(ngr / 2)) - nw %/% 2L)
  c0 <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(ngc / 2)) - nw %/% 2L)
  r1 <- (b0 - 1L) * fact + 1L; r2 <- min(nr, (b0 + nw - 1L) * fact)
  c1 <- (c0 - 1L) * fact + 1L; c2 <- min(nc, (c0 + nw - 1L) * fact)

  e <- terra::ext(terra::xFromCol(lossyear, c1) - rx / 2,
                  terra::xFromCol(lossyear, c2) + rx / 2,
                  terra::yFromRow(lossyear, r2) - ry / 2,
                  terra::yFromRow(lossyear, r1) + ry / 2)

  L <- terra::crop(lossyear, e);   Fr <- terra::crop(fireyear, e)
  Fo <- terra::crop(forest30, e);  Pe <- terra::crop(peat_bin30, e)

  bl <- count_blockwise(fact, L, Fr, Fo, Pe, label = "verification", quiet = TRUE)

  fo <- na0(Fo == 1); pe <- na0(Pe == 1)
  a_forest <- terra::aggregate(fo, fact, fun = "sum")
  a_pf     <- terra::aggregate(na0(fo & pe), fact, fun = "sum")
  fire_w   <- na0((Fr >= y_lo_rec) & (Fr <= y_hi_rec) & (fo == 1))
  a_fire   <- terra::aggregate(fire_w, fact, fun = "sum")
  loss_w   <- na0((L >= y_lo_rec) & (L <= y_hi_rec) & (fo == 1))
  a_nonf   <- terra::aggregate(na0(loss_w & (fire_w == 0)), fact, fun = "sum")
  yr_test  <- min(n_years, 24L)
  a_yr     <- terra::aggregate(na0((L == yr_test) & (fo == 1)), fact, fun = "sum")

  cmp <- function(mat, rst, nm) {
    a <- as.vector(t(mat))
    b <- as.vector(terra::values(rst))
    b[is.na(b)] <- 0
    if (length(a) != length(b)) return(sprintf("%s: length %d vs %d", nm, length(a), length(b)))
    d <- max(abs(a - b))
    if (d > 1e-6) sprintf("%s: max absolute difference %g", nm, d) else NA_character_
  }

  probs <- c(
    cmp(bl$n_forest,       a_forest, "n_forest"),
    cmp(bl$n_peat_forest,  a_pf,     "n_peat_forest"),
    cmp(bl$n_fire_rec,     a_fire,   "n_fire_rec"),
    cmp(bl$n_nonfire_rec,  a_nonf,   "n_nonfire_rec"),
    cmp(bl$ann_loss[, , yr_test], a_yr, paste0("annual loss ", 2000L + yr_test))
  )
  probs <- probs[!is.na(probs)]

  rm(L, Fr, Fo, Pe, fo, pe, fire_w, loss_w, a_forest, a_pf, a_fire, a_nonf, a_yr)
  sweep_temp()

  if (length(probs)) {
    msg("Block engine verification FAILED: ", paste(probs, collapse = "; "))
    FALSE
  } else {
    msg("Block engine verified against terra::aggregate on a ", nw, " by ", nw,
        " cell window. Counts match exactly.")
    TRUE
  }
}

if (isTRUE(cfg$verify_block_engine)) {
  block_engine_ok <- isTRUE(try(verify_block_engine(agg_fact), silent = TRUE))
  if (!block_engine_ok) {
    warning("The streaming count engine did not reproduce terra::aggregate. ",
            "Falling back to the slower whole-raster terra path.")
  }
} else {
  block_engine_ok <- TRUE
  msg("Block engine verification skipped by configuration.")
}
```

# Analysis grid and pixel counts

```{r grid-counts}
grid_path   <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "grid_counts.tif")
annual_path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "grid_annual_counts.tif")

grid_layer_names <- c(
  "n_forest", "n_peat", "n_peat_forest",
  paste0(c("n_loss", "n_fire", "n_nonfire", "n_loss_peat", "n_fire_peat"), "_rec"),
  paste0(c("n_loss", "n_fire", "n_nonfire", "n_loss_peat", "n_fire_peat"), "_base"),
  paste0(c("n_loss", "n_fire", "n_nonfire", "n_loss_peat", "n_fire_peat"), "_all")
)
annual_layer_names <- as.vector(vapply(
  cfg$year_min:cfg$year_max,
  function(y) sprintf(c("loss_%d", "fire_%d", "losspeat_%d", "firepeat_%d"), y),
  character(4)))

# Whole-raster terra path, used only if the streaming engine fails verification.
count_terra_fallback <- function(fact) {
  msg("Using the whole-raster terra counting path. This is slower and needs ",
      "more scratch space.")
  as_mat <- function(r) {
    matrix(as.vector(terra::values(r)), nrow = terra::nrow(r),
           ncol = terra::ncol(r), byrow = TRUE)
  }
  agg_mask <- function(expr, nm) {
    f1 <- scratch(paste0("fb_mask_", nm, ".tif"))
    f2 <- scratch(paste0("fb_agg_", nm, ".tif"))
    terra::ifel(is.na(expr), 0, expr, filename = f1, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_int)
    terra::aggregate(terra::rast(f1), fact, fun = "sum",
                     filename = f2, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_flt)
    M <- as_mat(terra::rast(f2))
    drop_scratch(c(f1, f2)); sweep_temp()
    M
  }
  ngr <- ceiling(terra::nrow(lossyear) / fact)
  ngc <- ceiling(terra::ncol(lossyear) / fact)
  out <- list(fact = fact, ngr = ngr, ngc = ngc, nyr = n_years)
  out$n_forest      <- agg_mask(forest30 == 1, "forest")
  out$n_peat        <- agg_mask(peat_bin30 == 1, "peat")
  out$n_peat_forest <- agg_mask((forest30 == 1) & (peat_bin30 == 1), "peatforest")

  ann_loss <- array(0, c(ngr, ngc, n_years)); ann_fire <- ann_loss
  ann_lp   <- ann_loss; ann_fp <- ann_loss
  for (y in cfg$year_min:cfg$year_max) {
    k <- y - 2000L
    msg("fallback annual counts ", y)
    ann_loss[, , k] <- agg_mask((lossyear == k) & (forest30 == 1), paste0("l", k))
    ann_fire[, , k] <- agg_mask((fireyear == k) & (forest30 == 1), paste0("f", k))
    ann_lp[, , k]   <- agg_mask((lossyear == k) & (forest30 == 1) & (peat_bin30 == 1), paste0("lp", k))
    ann_fp[, , k]   <- agg_mask((fireyear == k) & (forest30 == 1) & (peat_bin30 == 1), paste0("fp", k))
  }
  out$ann_loss <- ann_loss; out$ann_fire <- ann_fire
  out$ann_loss_peat <- ann_lp; out$ann_fire_peat <- ann_fp

  win <- list(rec  = c(y_lo_rec, y_hi_rec),
              base = c(cfg$base_window[1] - 2000L, cfg$base_window[2] - 2000L),
              all  = c(1L, n_years))
  sum_years <- function(A, lo, hi) {
    idx <- seq.int(max(1L, lo), min(n_years, hi))
    if (length(idx) == 1L) A[, , idx] else apply(A[, , idx, drop = FALSE], c(1, 2), sum)
  }
  for (w in names(win)) {
    lo <- win[[w]][1]; hi <- win[[w]][2]
    out[[paste0("n_loss_", w)]]      <- sum_years(ann_loss, lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_fire_", w)]]      <- sum_years(ann_fire, lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_loss_peat_", w)]] <- sum_years(ann_lp,   lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_fire_peat_", w)]] <- sum_years(ann_fp,   lo, hi)
    out[[paste0("n_nonfire_", w)]]   <- agg_mask(
      (lossyear >= lo) & (lossyear <= hi) & (forest30 == 1) &
        !((fireyear >= lo) & (fireyear <= hi)), paste0("nf_", w))
  }
  out
}

need_counts <- !(cached_ok(grid_path, nlyr = length(grid_layer_names),
                           label = "grid_counts.tif") &&
                 cached_ok(annual_path, nlyr = length(annual_layer_names),
                           label = "grid_annual_counts.tif"))

if (need_counts) {
  t_start <- Sys.time()
  cnt <- if (block_engine_ok) count_blockwise(agg_fact, label = "grid counts") else
    count_terra_fallback(agg_fact)
  msg("counting pass finished in ",
      round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins")), 1), " minutes")

  grid_mats <- list(
    cnt$n_forest, cnt$n_peat, cnt$n_peat_forest,
    cnt$n_loss_rec, cnt$n_fire_rec, cnt$n_nonfire_rec,
    cnt$n_loss_peat_rec, cnt$n_fire_peat_rec,
    cnt$n_loss_base, cnt$n_fire_base, cnt$n_nonfire_base,
    cnt$n_loss_peat_base, cnt$n_fire_peat_base,
    cnt$n_loss_all, cnt$n_fire_all, cnt$n_nonfire_all,
    cnt$n_loss_peat_all, cnt$n_fire_peat_all
  )
  stopifnot(length(grid_mats) == length(grid_layer_names))
  gc_stack <- terra::rast(lapply(grid_mats, mat_to_grid, fact = agg_fact))
  names(gc_stack) <- grid_layer_names
  terra::writeRaster(gc_stack, grid_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  rm(grid_mats, gc_stack); gc()

  ann_list <- vector("list", 4L * n_years)
  i <- 0L
  for (y in cfg$year_min:cfg$year_max) {
    k <- y - 2000L
    ann_list[[i + 1L]] <- mat_to_grid(cnt$ann_loss[, , k],      agg_fact)
    ann_list[[i + 2L]] <- mat_to_grid(cnt$ann_fire[, , k],      agg_fact)
    ann_list[[i + 3L]] <- mat_to_grid(cnt$ann_loss_peat[, , k], agg_fact)
    ann_list[[i + 4L]] <- mat_to_grid(cnt$ann_fire_peat[, , k], agg_fact)
    i <- i + 4L
  }
  ann_stack <- terra::rast(ann_list)
  names(ann_stack) <- annual_layer_names
  terra::writeRaster(ann_stack, annual_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  rm(ann_list, ann_stack, cnt); sweep_temp()
}
```

# Distance machinery

Two safe distance routines replace the terra calls that could exhaust memory
in native code.

`distance_to_vector_stripwise()` computes distance from an analysis grid to a
vector layer in horizontal strips. Every strip is compared against the whole
vector, so the result is identical to computing the grid in one call, but no
single terra call ever sees more than a few thousand cells.

`peat_edge_distance()` computes distance to the peat swamp forest edge at the
native CongoPeat resolution by streaming, and is described in detail below.

```{r distance-machinery}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Distance from a raster grid to a vector layer, computed in strips
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

distance_to_vector_stripwise <- function(tmpl, vec_sf, out_path, label,
                                         rows_per = 20L) {
  nr <- terra::nrow(tmpl); nc <- terra::ncol(tmpl)
  ry <- terra::yres(tmpl)
  v  <- terra::vect(vec_sf)
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": ", nrow(vec_sf), " features, ", nr,
      " rows in strips of ", rows_per)

  res <- numeric(nr * nc)
  rr <- 1L; done <- 0L
  while (rr <= nr) {
    nsub <- min(rows_per, nr - rr + 1L)
    e <- terra::ext(terra::xmin(tmpl), terra::xmax(tmpl),
                    terra::yFromRow(tmpl, rr + nsub - 1L) - ry / 2,
                    terra::yFromRow(tmpl, rr) + ry / 2)
    strip <- terra::crop(terra::setValues(tmpl, NA_real_), e)
    d <- terra::distance(strip, v)
    res[((rr - 1L) * nc + 1L):((rr - 1L + nsub) * nc)] <- as.vector(terra::values(d))
    rm(strip, d)
    rr <- rr + nsub; done <- done + 1L
    if (done %% 5L == 0L) msg("[distance] ", label, ": row ", rr - 1L, " of ", nr)
  }
  rm(v); gc()

  out <- terra::rast(tmpl)
  terra::values(out) <- res / 1000
  names(out) <- label
  terra::writeRaster(out, out_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW"))
  rm(res, out); gc()
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": written to ", out_path)
  terra::rast(out_path)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fast distance from a raster grid to a vector layer
#
# The line layers are densified so that no segment is longer than
# distance_vertex_m, their vertices go into a k-d tree, and every grid cell
# centre is matched to its nearest vertices. The reported value is then the
# true geodesic distance to the best of those candidates.
#
# This is an approximation to the distance to the nearest point on a segment,
# bounded above by half the densification interval, so 50 m at the default
# setting. The covariate is measured in kilometres on 5.5 km cells and enters
# the models as log1p(km), so a 50 m ceiling is immaterial. The exact
# alternative is available through cfg$distance_method = "exact", but on a
# 63,000 feature road layer it runs for many hours.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Densification is done on the coordinate matrix rather than with
# sf::st_segmentize(). For geographic coordinates that function dispatches to
# lwgeom, which is an optional sf dependency that needs liblwgeom and is
# frequently absent on macOS. Interpolating linearly in lon/lat along segments
# no longer than 100 m is indistinguishable from geodesic interpolation at
# this scale, and it removes the dependency entirely.
vector_reference_points <- function(vec_sf, interval_m = 100) {
  g  <- sf::st_geometry(vec_sf)
  cc <- sf::st_coordinates(g)
  rm(g)

  X <- as.numeric(cc[, "X"]); Y <- as.numeric(cc[, "Y"])
  grp_cols <- setdiff(colnames(cc), c("X", "Y", "Z", "M"))

  keep <- !is.na(X) & !is.na(Y)
  base_pts <- cbind(X[keep], Y[keep])

  # Point layers have no path structure, so there is nothing to densify.
  if (!length(grp_cols) || nrow(cc) < 2L) {
    rm(cc, X, Y); gc()
    return(base_pts)
  }

  grp <- do.call(paste, c(as.data.frame(cc[, grp_cols, drop = FALSE]), sep = "_"))
  rm(cc)

  n <- length(X)
  same <- grp[-n] == grp[-1] & !is.na(X[-n]) & !is.na(X[-1]) &
    !is.na(Y[-n]) & !is.na(Y[-1])
  rm(grp)
  if (!any(same)) { rm(X, Y); gc(); return(base_pts) }

  x1 <- X[-n][same]; y1 <- Y[-n][same]
  x2 <- X[-1][same]; y2 <- Y[-1][same]
  rm(X, Y, same, keep); gc()

  # Segment length in metres, using a local equirectangular scale.
  kx <- 111320 * cos((y1 + y2) / 2 * pi / 180)
  ky <- 110574
  seg_m <- sqrt(((x2 - x1) * kx)^2 + ((y2 - y1) * ky)^2)
  nseg  <- pmax(1L, as.integer(ceiling(seg_m / interval_m)))
  rm(kx, seg_m)

  add <- nseg - 1L
  keep_seg <- add > 0L
  if (!any(keep_seg)) {
    rm(x1, y1, x2, y2, nseg, add); gc()
    return(base_pts)
  }

  idx <- rep(which(keep_seg), add[keep_seg])
  tt  <- sequence(add[keep_seg]) / rep(nseg[keep_seg], add[keep_seg])
  newx <- x1[idx] + (x2[idx] - x1[idx]) * tt
  newy <- y1[idx] + (y2[idx] - y1[idx]) * tt
  rm(x1, y1, x2, y2, nseg, add, keep_seg, idx, tt); gc()

  out <- rbind(base_pts, cbind(newx, newy))
  rm(base_pts, newx, newy); gc()
  out[!is.na(out[, 1]) & !is.na(out[, 2]), , drop = FALSE]
}

distance_to_vector_fast <- function(tmpl, vec_sf, out_path, label,
                                    interval_m = 100, k = 3L) {
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": densifying ", nrow(vec_sf), " features to ",
      interval_m, " m")
  P <- vector_reference_points(vec_sf, interval_m)
  if (!nrow(P)) stop("[distance] ", label, ": no reference vertices produced.")
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": ", nrow(P), " reference vertices; building k-d tree")

  kx <- 111320; ky <- 110574
  ref_metric <- cbind(P[, 1] * kx, P[, 2] * ky)
  storage.mode(ref_metric) <- "double"
  nn <- nn_index_builder(ref_metric, backend = .nn_backend_selected)
  rm(ref_metric); gc()
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": querying ", terra::ncell(tmpl),
      " cells with the ", nn$backend, " backend")

  # There are only about 25,000 analysis-grid cells, so one query is both
  # smaller and safer than repeatedly rebuilding an RANN/FNN tree in chunks.
  # The wrapper has already normalised and validated the return type.
  xy <- terra::xyFromCell(tmpl, seq_len(terra::ncell(tmpl)))
  q_metric <- cbind(xy[, 1] * kx, xy[, 2] * ky)
  storage.mode(q_metric) <- "double"
  idx <- nn$query(q_metric, min(as.integer(k), nrow(P)))
  rm(nn, q_metric); gc()
  dmin <- rep(Inf, nrow(xy))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(idx))) {
    dj <- terra::distance(xy, P[idx[, j], , drop = FALSE],
                          lonlat = TRUE, pairwise = TRUE)
    dmin <- pmin(dmin, dj)
    rm(dj)
  }
  rm(idx, P); gc()

  out <- terra::rast(tmpl)
  terra::values(out) <- dmin / 1000
  names(out) <- label
  terra::writeRaster(out, out_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW"))
  rm(dmin, out, xy); gc()
  msg("[distance] ", label, ": written to ", out_path)
  terra::rast(out_path)
}

# A small sidecar file records which method produced a cached distance raster,
# so mixing methods across covariates cannot happen silently.
method_tag   <- function(path) paste0(path, ".method")
read_method  <- function(path) {
  f <- method_tag(path)
  if (file.exists(f)) tryCatch(readLines(f, warn = FALSE)[1],
                               error = function(e) NA_character_) else NA_character_
}
write_method <- function(path, m) {
  writeLines(paste0(m, " interval_m=", cfg$distance_vertex_m), method_tag(path))
  invisible(path)
}
current_method_string <- function() {
  paste0(cfg$distance_method, " interval_m=", cfg$distance_vertex_m)
}

build_distance_raster <- function(tmpl, vec_sf, out_path, label) {
  r <- if (identical(cfg$distance_method, "exact")) {
    distance_to_vector_stripwise(tmpl, vec_sf, out_path, label)
  } else {
    distance_to_vector_fast(tmpl, vec_sf, out_path, label,
                            interval_m = cfg$distance_vertex_m)
  }
  write_method(out_path, cfg$distance_method)
  r
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Nearest-neighbour backend
#
# nn_index_builder(), output normalisation, package fallback and the functional
# self-test are defined in the package preflight chunk above. Keeping one
# central implementation ensures the road/rivers/settlements and peat-edge
# calculations cannot drift onto different untested backend APIs.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inner boundary cells of the peat swamp forest class, extracted by streaming
#
# A cell is an inner boundary cell when it belongs to the peat class and at
# least one of its eight neighbours does not. That is the same rule as
# terra::boundaries(inner = TRUE, classes = FALSE, directions = 8). Slabs are
# read with a one row halo so the test is correct across slab joins, and only
# the coordinates of the boundary cells are kept.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

peat_edge_points <- function(pr, pclass, rows_per = 200L) {
  nr <- terra::nrow(pr); nc <- terra::ncol(pr)
  xs <- terra::xFromCol(pr, seq_len(nc))
  terra::readStart(pr)
  on.exit(try(terra::readStop(pr), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  acc <- list(); rr <- 1L; done <- 0L
  while (rr <= nr) {
    nsub <- min(rows_per, nr - rr + 1L)
    r0 <- max(1L, rr - 1L)
    r1 <- min(nr, rr + nsub)
    v <- terra::readValues(pr, row = r0, nrows = r1 - r0 + 1L, col = 1, ncols = nc)
    v[is.na(v)] <- -1
    M <- matrix(as.integer(v == pclass), nrow = nc)   # columns are raster rows
    rm(v)
    nrr <- ncol(M)

    P <- matrix(0L, nc + 2L, nrr + 2L)
    P[2:(nc + 1L), 2:(nrr + 1L)] <- M
    S <- P[1:nc, 1:nrr] + P[2:(nc + 1L), 1:nrr] + P[3:(nc + 2L), 1:nrr] +
         P[1:nc, 2:(nrr + 1L)] + P[2:(nc + 1L), 2:(nrr + 1L)] +
         P[3:(nc + 2L), 2:(nrr + 1L)] +
         P[1:nc, 3:(nrr + 2L)] + P[2:(nc + 1L), 3:(nrr + 2L)] +
         P[3:(nc + 2L), 3:(nrr + 2L)]
    rm(P)
    B <- (M == 1L) & (S < 9L)
    rm(M, S)

    keep_lo <- rr - r0 + 1L
    B <- B[, keep_lo:(keep_lo + nsub - 1L), drop = FALSE]
    idx <- which(B)
    rm(B)
    if (length(idx)) {
      ci <- ((idx - 1L) %% nc) + 1L
      ri <- ((idx - 1L) %/% nc) + rr
      acc[[length(acc) + 1L]] <- cbind(xs[ci], terra::yFromRow(pr, ri))
      rm(ci, ri)
    }
    rm(idx)
    rr <- rr + nsub; done <- done + 1L
    if (done %% 10L == 0L) msg("[peat-edge] boundary scan: row ", rr - 1L, " of ", nr)
  }
  if (!length(acc)) return(matrix(numeric(0), ncol = 2))
  out <- do.call(rbind, acc)
  rm(acc); gc()
  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Distance to the peat edge, streamed, and averaged onto the analysis grid
#
# For every 100 m cell the nearest boundary points are found with a k-d tree
# built in a local equirectangular metric, then the true geodesic distance to
# those candidates is computed and the smallest is taken. Ranking in the local
# metric is safe here: the domain sits within 3.5 degrees of the equator, so
# east-west scale distortion is under 0.2 per cent, and k candidates are
# checked geodesically rather than one.
#
# The analysis grid value is the mean of the 100 m distances whose cell centre
# falls in that grid cell, accumulated during the same pass.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

peat_edge_distance <- function(pr, tmpl, edge_lonlat, out100 = NULL,
                               rows_per = 200L, k = 2L) {
  nr <- terra::nrow(pr); nc <- terra::ncol(pr)
  xs <- terra::xFromCol(pr, seq_len(nc))

  kx <- 111320; ky <- 110574
  E_proj <- cbind(edge_lonlat[, 1] * kx, edge_lonlat[, 2] * ky)
  storage.mode(E_proj) <- "double"
  n_edge_ref <- nrow(E_proj)
  nn <- nn_index_builder(E_proj, backend = .nn_backend_selected)
  rm(E_proj); gc()
  msg("[peat-edge] computing distance using a ", nn$backend,
      " k-d tree over ", n_edge_ref, " boundary points, k = ", k)

  ncell_t <- terra::ncell(tmpl); ngc_t <- terra::ncol(tmpl)
  sum_acc <- numeric(ncell_t); cnt_acc <- numeric(ncell_t)
  tcol_all <- terra::colFromX(tmpl, xs)

  w <- NULL
  if (!is.null(out100)) {
    w <- terra::rast(pr)
    terra::writeStart(w, out100, overwrite = TRUE,
                      datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  }

  rr <- 1L; done <- 0L
  while (rr <= nr) {
    nsub <- min(rows_per, nr - rr + 1L)
    lat_b <- terra::yFromRow(pr, rr:(rr + nsub - 1L))
    qlon <- rep(xs, times = nsub)
    qlat <- rep(lat_b, each = nc)

    idx <- nn$query(cbind(qlon * kx, qlat * ky), k)
    dmin <- rep(Inf, length(qlon))
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(idx))) {
      ej <- edge_lonlat[idx[, j], , drop = FALSE]
      dj <- terra::distance(cbind(qlon, qlat), ej, lonlat = TRUE, pairwise = TRUE)
      dmin <- pmin(dmin, dj)
      rm(ej, dj)
    }
    rm(idx)
    d_km <- dmin / 1000
    rm(dmin)

    if (!is.null(w)) terra::writeValues(w, d_km, rr, nsub)

    trow <- rep(terra::rowFromY(tmpl, lat_b), each = nc)
    tcol <- rep(tcol_all, times = nsub)
    key  <- (trow - 1L) * ngc_t + tcol
    ok <- !is.na(key) & key >= 1L & key <= ncell_t & is.finite(d_km)
    if (any(ok)) {
      ag <- rowsum(cbind(d_km[ok], 1), key[ok], reorder = FALSE)
      ki <- as.integer(rownames(ag))
      sum_acc[ki] <- sum_acc[ki] + ag[, 1]
      cnt_acc[ki] <- cnt_acc[ki] + ag[, 2]
      rm(ag, ki)
    }
    rm(qlon, qlat, d_km, trow, tcol, key, ok)

    rr <- rr + nsub; done <- done + 1L
    if (done %% 5L == 0L) msg("[peat-edge] distance pass: row ", rr - 1L, " of ", nr)
  }
  if (!is.null(w)) terra::writeStop(w)
  rm(nn); gc()

  msg("[peat-edge] transferring distance to the analysis grid")
  vals <- ifelse(cnt_acc > 0, sum_acc / cnt_acc, NA_real_)
  out <- terra::rast(tmpl)
  terra::values(out) <- vals
  names(out) <- "d_peat_edge_km"
  rm(sum_acc, cnt_acc, vals); gc()
  out
}
```

# Cell covariates

Distance rasters are the slowest small-raster step in the workflow, so each is
computed once and cached in `data/processed/`.

```{r covariates}
template_na <- terra::setValues(template, NA_real_)

dist_km_cached <- function(vec_sf, name) {
  path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, paste0(name, ".tif"))
  discard_if_invalid(path, label = paste0(name, ".tif"))

  have <- read_method(path)
  want <- current_method_string()
  method_matches <- identical(have, want)
  if (file.exists(path) && !method_matches) {
    msg("[distance] ", name, " was built with ",
        ifelse(is.na(have), "an earlier version of this script", have),
        " but cfg asks for ", want, ". Rebuilding for consistency.")
  }

  if (method_matches &&
      cached_ok(path, ref = template, nlyr = 1, label = paste0(name, ".tif"))) {
    r <- terra::rast(path); names(r) <- name; return(r)
  }
  if (is.null(vec_sf) || nrow(vec_sf) == 0) {
    msg("no features for ", name, "; covariate set to NA")
    r <- template_na; names(r) <- name
    terra::writeRaster(r, path, overwrite = TRUE,
                       datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW"))
    write_method(path, cfg$distance_method)
    return(terra::rast(path))
  }
  r <- build_distance_raster(template, vec_sf, path, name)
  sweep_temp()
  names(r) <- name
  r
}

# Distance to the edge of the peat swamp forest.

edge_path  <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "d_peat_edge_km.tif")
edge_path100 <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "d_peat_edge_km_100m.tif")

# Remove anything left behind by the aborted V6 session. These names are no
# longer produced by the workflow, and a truncated file must never be reused.
for (stale_f in c(scratch("peat_bin100.tif"), scratch("peat_edge100.tif"),
                  scratch("peat_edge_dist.tif"))) {

    msg("[peat-edge] removing obsolete scratch file: ", stale_f)
    unlink(stale_f); unlink(paste0(stale_f, ".aux.xml"))
  }
}

              label = "d_peat_edge_km.tif")) {
  msg("[peat-edge] validating final cached raster")
  msg("[peat-edge] cached product accepted, stage skipped")
} else {
  msg("[peat-edge] validating peat raster")
  if (!validate_geotiff(peat100_path)) {
    stop("[peat-edge] the 100 m peat classification at ", peat100_path,
         " could not be read. Delete it and rerun the peat-on-hansen chunk.")
  }
  pr_edge <- terra::rast(peat100_path)
  msg("[peat-edge] peat raster: ", terra::nrow(pr_edge), " x ",
      terra::ncol(pr_edge), " cells at ", signif(terra::xres(pr_edge), 3), " deg")

  msg("[peat-edge] creating binary peat mask and boundary by streaming")
  edge_xy <- peat_edge_points(pr_edge, .pclass,
                              rows_per = max(50L, cfg$block_rows_target * 2L))
  if (!nrow(edge_xy)) {
    stop("[peat-edge] no peat swamp forest boundary cells were found in ",
         peat100_path, ". Check that class ", .pclass,
         " is present in the CongoPeat classification.")
  }
  msg("[peat-edge] boundary cells found: ", nrow(edge_xy))

  d_edge_grid <- peat_edge_distance(
    pr_edge, template, edge_xy,
    out100 = if (isTRUE(cfg$write_peat_edge_100m)) edge_path100 else NULL,
    rows_per = max(50L, cfg$block_rows_target * 2L),
    k = 2L
  )

  terra::writeRaster(d_edge_grid, edge_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW"))
  rm(d_edge_grid, edge_xy, pr_edge); sweep_temp()

  msg("[peat-edge] validating final cached raster")
  if (!cached_ok(edge_path, ref = template, nlyr = 1, min_bytes = 2048,
                 label = "d_peat_edge_km.tif")) {
    stop("[peat-edge] the raster just written to ", edge_path,
         " failed validation. Delete it and rerun this chunk.")
  }
  msg("[peat-edge] completed successfully")
}
```

```{r rainfall-covariate}
if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps)) {
# Per-cell dry season = three consecutive months with the lowest climatological
# mean, evaluated on the CHIRPS grid then moved to the analysis grid.
rain_path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, "rain_covariates.tif")

if (!cached_ok(rain_path, ref = template, label = "rain_covariates.tif")) {
  msg("building the dry-season rainfall covariates")
  nm  <- names(chirps)
  yr  <- as.integer(substr(nm, 3, 6))
  mo  <- as.integer(substr(nm, 8, 9))

  clim <- terra::rast(lapply(1:12, function(m) {
    idx <- which(mo == m)
    terra::app(chirps[[idx]], fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  names(clim) <- sprintf("clim_%02d", 1:12)

  roll3 <- terra::rast(lapply(1:12, function(m) {
    idx <- ((m - 1 + 0:2) %% 12) + 1
    sum(clim[[idx]])
  }))
  names(roll3) <- sprintf("roll_%02d", 1:12)
  dry_start <- terra::which.min(roll3)
  names(dry_start) <- "dry_start_month"
  rm(roll3)

  uy <- sort(unique(yr))
  dry_totals <- terra::rast(lapply(uy, function(y) {
    acc <- terra::setValues(clim[[1]], 0)
    for (m in 1:12) {
      idx <- ((m - 1 + 0:2) %% 12) + 1
      wanted <- which(yr == y & mo %in% idx)
      if (!length(wanted)) next
      tot <- sum(chirps[[wanted]])
      acc <- terra::ifel(dry_start == m, tot, acc)
    }
    acc
  }))
  names(dry_totals) <- paste0("dry_", uy)

  dry_mean <- terra::app(dry_totals, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  dry_sd   <- terra::app(dry_totals, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
  dry_z    <- (dry_totals - dry_mean) / dry_sd
  names(dry_z) <- paste0("dryz_", uy)

  rec_yrs <- cfg$recent_window[1]:cfg$recent_window[2]
  have_rec <- paste0("dryz_", rec_yrs)
  have_rec <- have_rec[have_rec %in% names(dry_z)]
  dry_z_rec <- terra::app(dry_z[[have_rec]], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(dry_z_rec) <- "dry_z_recent"

  rain_out <- c(
    terra::resample(dry_mean,  template, method = "bilinear"),
    terra::resample(dry_z_rec, template, method = "bilinear"),
    terra::resample(dry_z,     template, method = "bilinear")
  )
  names(rain_out) <- c("dry_mean_mm", "dry_z_recent", names(dry_z))
  terra::writeRaster(rain_out, rain_path, overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"))
  rm(clim, dry_totals, dry_z, dry_mean, dry_sd, dry_z_rec, dry_start, rain_out)
  sweep_temp()
}
rain_cov <- terra::rast(rain_path)
msg("Rainfall covariate layers: ", terra::nlyr(rain_cov))
} else {
  rain_cov <- NULL
  msg("Rainfall covariates skipped because CHIRPS is disabled.")
}
```

```{r assemble}
stack_all <- c(grid_counts, covars)
if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps) && exists("rain_cov")) {
  stack_all <- c(stack_all, rain_cov[[c("dry_mean_mm", "dry_z_recent")]])
}

dat <- terra::as.data.frame(stack_all, xy = TRUE, cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
dat <- tibble::as_tibble(dat)
rm(stack_all); gc()

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pix_ha        = cell_ha / npix,
    forest_ha     = n_forest * pix_ha,
    peat_ha       = n_peat * pix_ha,
    peat_forest_ha= n_peat_forest * pix_ha,
    peat_frac     = ifelse(n_forest > 0, n_peat_forest / n_forest, NA_real_),
    loss_ha_rec   = n_loss_rec * pix_ha,
    fire_ha_rec   = n_fire_rec * pix_ha,
    nonfire_ha_rec= n_nonfire_rec * pix_ha,
    loss_ha_base  = n_loss_base * pix_ha,
    fire_ha_base  = n_fire_base * pix_ha,
    fire_share_rec  = ifelse(n_loss_rec  > 0, n_fire_rec  / n_loss_rec,  NA_real_),
    fire_share_base = ifelse(n_loss_base > 0, n_fire_base / n_loss_base, NA_real_),
    iso3 = iso_num$iso3[match(country_id, iso_num$id)],
    adm1_name = adm1$adm1_name[match(adm1_id, adm1$adm1_id)],
    protected = pa_frac >= 0.5
  )

n_start <- nrow(dat)
dat_model <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(n_forest),
    n_forest >= 0.10 * npix,
    !is.na(iso3),
    !is.na(d_road_km), !is.na(d_river_km), !is.na(d_settle_km),
    !is.na(d_peat_edge_km), !is.na(pa_frac)
  )
if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps)) {
  dat_model <- dplyr::filter(dat_model, !is.na(dry_z_recent))
}

msg("Cells before filtering: ", n_start, "; after: ", nrow(dat_model))

incl <- tibble::tibble(
  step = c("all grid cells in domain",
           "with baseline forest >= 10 % of cell",
           "with country assigned",
           "with all covariates non-missing"),
  n = c(n_start,
        sum(!is.na(dat$n_forest) & dat$n_forest >= 0.10 * npix, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(!is.na(dat$n_forest) & dat$n_forest >= 0.10 * npix & !is.na(dat$iso3), na.rm = TRUE),
        nrow(dat_model))
)
write_table(incl, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_S1_inclusion_flow.csv"))
print(incl)

write_table(dat,       file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "analysis_grid_full.csv"))
write_table(dat_model, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "analysis_grid_model.csv"))

# dat is not used again; dat_model carries everything downstream.
rm(dat); gc()
```

```{r assemble-panel}
ann_df <- terra::as.data.frame(annual_counts, cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
if (!"cell" %in% names(ann_df)) ann_df$cell <- seq_len(nrow(ann_df))
ann_df$cell <- as.integer(ann_df$cell)

# Keep only cells that survive the inclusion criteria before reshaping, which
# cuts the long panel roughly in half before it is ever built.
ann_df <- ann_df[ann_df$cell %in% dat_model$cell, , drop = FALSE]

panel <- ann_df |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -cell,
    names_to = c("metric", "year"),
    names_pattern = "^(loss|fire|losspeat|firepeat)_(\\d{4})$",
    values_to = "n"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = n) |>
  dplyr::rename(n_loss = loss, n_fire = fire,
                n_loss_peat = losspeat, n_fire_peat = firepeat) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_nonfire = pmax(n_loss - n_fire, 0))
rm(ann_df); gc()

cell_static <- dat_model |>
  dplyr::select(cell, x, y, iso3, adm1_name, pix_ha, forest_ha, peat_frac,
                d_road_km, d_mroad_km, d_river_km, d_settle_km,
                d_peat_edge_km, pa_frac, protected,
                dplyr::any_of(c("conc_frac", "dry_mean_mm")))

panel <- dplyr::inner_join(panel, cell_static, by = "cell")
rm(cell_static); gc()

if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps) && exists("rain_cov")) {
  dz <- terra::as.data.frame(rain_cov[[grep("^dryz_", names(rain_cov))]],
                             cells = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)
  if (!"cell" %in% names(dz)) dz$cell <- seq_len(nrow(dz))
  dz$cell <- as.integer(dz$cell)
  dz <- dz[dz$cell %in% panel$cell, , drop = FALSE]
  dz <- tibble::as_tibble(dz) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-cell, names_to = "year", values_to = "dry_z",
                        names_prefix = "dryz_") |>
    dplyr::mutate(year = as.integer(year))
  panel <- dplyr::left_join(panel, dz, by = c("cell", "year"))
  rm(dz); gc()
}

panel <- panel |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    loss_ha    = n_loss * pix_ha,
    fire_ha    = n_fire * pix_ha,
    nonfire_ha = n_nonfire * pix_ha,
    fire_ha_peat = n_fire_peat * pix_ha,
    loss_ha_peat = n_loss_peat * pix_ha
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(forest_ha > 0)

msg("Panel rows: ", nrow(panel), " (", dplyr::n_distinct(panel$cell), " cells x ",
    dplyr::n_distinct(panel$year), " years)")
write_table(panel, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "analysis_panel_cell_year.csv"))
gc()
```

```{r model-prep}
rhs <- c("peat_frac", "l_road", "l_river", "l_settle", "l_edge", "pa_frac")

form_fire    <- as.formula(paste("n_fire_rec ~",    paste(rhs, collapse = " + "),
                                 "+ offset(log_forest)"))

                                 "+ offset(log_forest)"))
print(form_fire)
```

```{r model-primary}
m_fire <- MASS::glm.nb(form_fire, data = mdat, control = glm.control(maxit = 200))
summary(m_fire)

m_nonfire <- MASS::glm.nb(form_nonfire, data = mdat, control = glm.control(maxit = 200))
summary(m_nonfire)

tidy_nb <- function(m, label) {
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  tibble::tibble(
    model = label, term = rownames(co),
    estimate = co[, 1], se = co[, 2], z = co[, 3], p = co[, 4]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      rate_ratio = exp(estimate),
      rr_lo = exp(estimate - 1.96 * se),
      rr_hi = exp(estimate + 1.96 * se)
    )
}

tab_primary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tidy_nb(m_fire, "fire-driven loss 2023-2025"),
  tidy_nb(m_nonfire, "non-fire loss 2023-2025")
)
write_table(tab_primary, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_4_primary_models.csv"))
knitr::kable(tab_primary, digits = 4)
```

```{r model-panel}
# Keep only the columns the panel models need. On an 8 GB machine the model
# frame for a 600 thousand row negative binomial is one of the larger objects
# in the session, so it is built from a minimal data frame.
panel_cols <- c("cell", "year", "n_fire", "forest_ha", "peat_frac",
                "d_road_km", "d_river_km", "d_settle_km", "d_peat_edge_km",
                "pa_frac", "iso3")
if ("dry_z" %in% names(panel)) panel_cols <- c(panel_cols, "dry_z")

pdat <- panel[, panel_cols] |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    log_forest = log(pmax(forest_ha, 1e-6)),
    l_road = log1p(d_road_km), l_river = log1p(d_river_km),
    l_settle = log1p(d_settle_km), l_edge = log1p(d_peat_edge_km),
    year_f = factor(year),
    iso3 = factor(iso3)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-d_road_km, -d_river_km, -d_settle_km, -d_peat_edge_km, -forest_ha)

# The full panel is no longer needed: annual_summary, window_summary,
# pa_summary and rain_year were all computed above.
rm(panel); gc()

prhs <- c("peat_frac", "l_road", "l_river", "l_settle", "l_edge", "pa_frac", "year_f")
if (nlevels(pdat$iso3) > 1) prhs <- c(prhs, "iso3")
if (isTRUE(cfg$use_chirps) && "dry_z" %in% names(pdat)) prhs <- c(prhs, "dry_z")

form_panel <- as.formula(paste("n_fire ~", paste(prhs, collapse = " + "),
                               "+ offset(log_forest)"))

msg("fitting the panel negative binomial on ", nrow(pdat), " rows")
m_panel <- MASS::glm.nb(form_panel, data = pdat, control = glm.control(maxit = 100))

vc <- sandwich::vcovCL(m_panel, cluster = pdat$cell, type = "HC0")
ct <- lmtest::coeftest(m_panel, vcov. = vc)

tab_panel <- tibble::tibble(
  model = "panel NB, fire-driven loss 2001-2025, cluster-robust by cell",
  term = rownames(ct),
  estimate = ct[, 1], se = ct[, 2], z = ct[, 3], p = ct[, 4]
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rate_ratio = exp(estimate),
                rr_lo = exp(estimate - 1.96 * se),
                rr_hi = exp(estimate + 1.96 * se))

write_table(tab_panel, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_5_panel_model.csv"))
knitr::kable(head(tab_panel, 25), digits = 4)
rm(vc, ct); gc()
```

```{r robust-grid-size}
# Refit the primary specification on coarser and finer grids. Each grid size
# is one streaming pass, and the distance rasters at each resolution are
# cached so a rerun does not repeat them.
refit_at_grid <- function(gdeg) {
  f <- as.integer(round(gdeg / terra::res(lossyear)[1]))
  msg("grid-size sensitivity: ", gdeg, " degrees (factor ", f, ")")

  cs <- if (block_engine_ok) count_blockwise(f, label = paste0("counts at ", gdeg)) else
    count_terra_fallback(f)

  tmpl_f  <- mat_to_grid(cs$n_forest, f)
  tn_f    <- terra::setValues(tmpl_f, NA_real_)

  dist_at <- function(vec_sf, nm) {
    path <- file.path(cfg$proc_dir, sprintf("%s_grid%s.tif", nm,
                                            gsub("\\.", "p", format(gdeg))))
    discard_if_invalid(path, label = basename(path))
    if (identical(read_method(path), current_method_string()) &&
        cached_ok(path, ref = tmpl_f, nlyr = 1, label = basename(path))) {
      return(terra::rast(path))
    }
    # Same routine as the main grid, so the sensitivity analysis and the
    # primary analysis use one definition of distance.
    build_distance_raster(tmpl_f, vec_sf, path,
                          sprintf("%s at %s deg", nm, gdeg))
  }

  road_r  <- dist_at(roads_all,  "d_road_km")
  river_r <- dist_at(rivers,     "d_river_km")
  set_r   <- dist_at(places_pop, "d_settle_km")
  area_r  <- terra::cellSize(tmpl_f, unit = "ha")

  d <- tibble::tibble(
    n_forest      = as.vector(t(cs$n_forest)),
    n_peat_forest = as.vector(t(cs$n_peat_forest)),
    n_fire        = as.vector(t(cs$n_fire_rec)),
    cell_ha       = as.vector(terra::values(area_r)),
    d_road_km     = as.vector(terra::values(road_r)),
    d_river_km    = as.vector(terra::values(river_r)),
    d_settle_km   = as.vector(terra::values(set_r))
  )
  rm(cs, tmpl_f, tn_f, road_r, river_r, set_r, area_r); sweep_temp()

  d$pix_ha    <- d$cell_ha / (f^2)
  d$forest_ha <- d$n_forest * d$pix_ha
  d$peat_frac <- ifelse(d$n_forest > 0, d$n_peat_forest / d$n_forest, NA_real_)
  d <- d |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_forest), n_forest >= 0.10 * f^2,
                  !is.na(d_road_km), !is.na(d_river_km), !is.na(d_settle_km)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(log_forest = log(pmax(forest_ha, 1e-6)),
                  l_road = log1p(d_road_km), l_river = log1p(d_river_km),
                  l_settle = log1p(d_settle_km))
  m <- MASS::glm.nb(n_fire ~ peat_frac + l_road + l_river + l_settle + offset(log_forest),
                    data = d, control = glm.control(maxit = 200))
  co <- summary(m)$coefficients
  out <- tibble::tibble(grid_deg = gdeg, n_cells = nrow(d), term = rownames(co),
                        estimate = co[, 1], se = co[, 2], p = co[, 4]) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rate_ratio = exp(estimate))
  rm(d, m); gc()
  out
}

grid_sens <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cfg$grid_deg_sens, function(g) {
  out <- try(refit_at_grid(g), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) {
    msg("grid-size sensitivity failed at ", g, " degrees: ",
        attr(out, "condition")$message)
    NULL
  } else out
}))
write_table(grid_sens, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_S7_grid_size_sensitivity.csv"))
knitr::kable(grid_sens, digits = 4)
sweep_temp()
```

```{r robust-canopy-threshold}
if (isTRUE(have_treecover)) {
# One streaming pass covers all three canopy thresholds. Areas use exact
# per-row geodesic pixel areas, so they match a cellSize based calculation.
canopy_threshold_areas <- function(thresholds) {
  nr <- terra::nrow(lossyear); nc <- terra::ncol(lossyear)
  strip <- terra::rast(nrows = nr, ncols = 1,
                       xmin = terra::xmin(lossyear),
                       xmax = terra::xmin(lossyear) + terra::xres(lossyear),
                       ymin = terra::ymin(lossyear), ymax = terra::ymax(lossyear),
                       crs = terra::crs(lossyear))
  row_ha <- as.vector(terra::values(terra::cellSize(strip, unit = "ha")))
  rm(strip)

  acc <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) c(forest = 0, peat_forest = 0,
                                           loss = 0, fire = 0))
  names(acc) <- as.character(thresholds)

  terra::readStart(treecover); terra::readStart(peat30)
  terra::readStart(lossyear);  terra::readStart(fireyear)
  on.exit({
    try(terra::readStop(treecover), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(peat30), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(lossyear), silent = TRUE)
    try(terra::readStop(fireyear), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  rows_per <- max(1L, cfg$block_rows_target)
  rr <- 1L
  while (rr <= nr) {
    nsub <- min(rows_per, nr - rr + 1L)
    TC <- terra::readValues(treecover, row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
    PC <- terra::readValues(peat30,    row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
    Lv <- terra::readValues(lossyear,  row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
    Fv <- terra::readValues(fireyear,  row = rr, nrows = nsub, col = 1, ncols = nc)
    TC[is.na(TC)] <- -1; PC[is.na(PC)] <- -1
    Lv[is.na(Lv)] <- 0;  Fv[is.na(Fv)] <- 0
    ha <- row_ha[rr:(rr + nsub - 1L)]
    inL <- Lv >= y_lo_rec & Lv <= y_hi_rec
    inF <- Fv >= y_lo_rec & Fv <= y_hi_rec
    pe  <- PC == .pclass

    for (th in thresholds) {
      fo <- (TC >= th) & (PC %in% .fclasses)
      rs <- function(v) colSums(matrix(as.numeric(v), nrow = nc))
      k <- as.character(th)
      acc[[k]]["forest"]      <- acc[[k]]["forest"]      + sum(rs(fo) * ha)
      acc[[k]]["peat_forest"] <- acc[[k]]["peat_forest"] + sum(rs(fo & pe) * ha)
      acc[[k]]["loss"]        <- acc[[k]]["loss"]        + sum(rs(fo & inL) * ha)
      acc[[k]]["fire"]        <- acc[[k]]["fire"]        + sum(rs(fo & inF) * ha)
    }
    rm(TC, PC, Lv, Fv, inL, inF, pe)
    if ((rr %/% rows_per) %% 50L == 0L) msg("canopy threshold pass: row ", rr, " of ", nr)
    rr <- rr + nsub
  }
  acc
}

acc_th <- canopy_threshold_areas(cfg$forest_thresh_sens)
thresh_sens <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cfg$forest_thresh_sens, function(th) {
  a <- acc_th[[as.character(th)]]
  tibble::tibble(
    canopy_threshold_pct = th,
    forest_ha      = a[["forest"]],
    peat_forest_ha = a[["peat_forest"]],
    loss_ha_recent = a[["loss"]],
    fire_ha_recent = a[["fire"]]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(fire_share_recent = fire_ha_recent / loss_ha_recent,
                  recent_loss_pct_of_forest = 100 * loss_ha_recent / forest_ha)
}))
write_table(thresh_sens, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_S8_canopy_threshold_sensitivity.csv"))
knitr::kable(thresh_sens, digits = 4)
rm(acc_th); sweep_temp()
} else {
  msg("Canopy-threshold sensitivity skipped because Hansen treecover2000 is unavailable.")
}
```

```{r robust-spatial-autocorrelation}
set.seed(cfg$seed)
res_df <- mdat |>
  dplyr::mutate(resid = residuals(m_fire, type = "pearson")) |>
  dplyr::select(x, y, resid)

n_sub <- min(3000L, nrow(res_df))
sub <- res_df[sample.int(nrow(res_df), n_sub), ]
rm(res_df); gc()

morans_I <- function(sub, cutoff_km = 25) {
  xy <- as.matrix(sub[, c("x", "y")])
  z  <- sub$resid - mean(sub$resid)
  dm <- as.matrix(dist(xy)) * 111.32
  W  <- ifelse(dm > 0 & dm <= cutoff_km, 1 / dm, 0)
  rm(dm)
  S0 <- sum(W)
  n  <- length(z)
  I  <- (n / S0) * (t(z) %*% W %*% z) / sum(z^2)
  EI <- -1 / (n - 1)
  perm <- replicate(199, {
    zp <- sample(z)
    as.numeric((n / S0) * (t(zp) %*% W %*% zp) / sum(zp^2))
  })
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    cutoff_km = cutoff_km, n = n,
    morans_I = as.numeric(I), expected_I = EI,
    perm_mean = mean(perm), perm_sd = sd(perm),
    p_perm = (1 + sum(abs(perm - EI) >= abs(as.numeric(I) - EI))) / 200
  )
  rm(W); gc()
  out
}

moran_tab <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(15, 25, 50), function(k) morans_I(sub, k)))
write_table(moran_tab, file.path(cfg$diag_dir, "table_S9_morans_I_residuals.csv"))
knitr::kable(moran_tab, digits = 4)
rm(sub); gc()
```

```{r diagnostics}
vif_manual <- function(model) {
  X <- model.matrix(model)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  X <- X[, apply(X, 2, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1), drop = FALSE]
  out <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j) {
    r2 <- summary(lm(X[, j] ~ X[, -j, drop = FALSE]))$r.squared
    1 / (1 - r2)
  }, numeric(1))
  res <- tibble::tibble(term = colnames(X), vif = out)
  rm(X); gc()
  res
}
vif_tab <- vif_manual(m_fire)
```

# GeoTIFF exports

```{r export-geotiffs}
# base::pmax() is not defined for SpatRaster and can fail in terra's comparison
# machinery. Build the same denominator with a terra-native raster operation.
forest_count_r <- grid_counts[["n_forest"]]
forest_den_r <- terra::ifel(forest_count_r < 1, 1, forest_count_r)

fire_rate_r <- (grid_counts[["n_fire_rec"]] / forest_den_r) * 100
names(fire_rate_r) <- "fire_loss_pct_of_forest_recent"
write_tif(fire_rate_r,
          file.path(cfg$tif_dir, "fire_loss_pct_of_forest_2023_2025.tif"))

nonfire_rate_r <- (grid_counts[["n_nonfire_rec"]] / forest_den_r) * 100
names(nonfire_rate_r) <- "nonfire_loss_pct_of_forest_recent"
write_tif(nonfire_rate_r,
          file.path(cfg$tif_dir, "nonfire_loss_pct_of_forest_2023_2025.tif"))

write_tif(peat_coarse,
          file.path(cfg$tif_dir, "peat_swamp_forest_fraction_grid.tif"))

# The only 30 m export. Written in one streaming pass as a one-byte layer.
fire_peat_tif <- file.path(cfg$tif_dir, "fire_on_peat_swamp_forest_2023_2025_30m.tif")
if (!validate_geotiff(fire_peat_tif)) {
  msg("writing the 30 m fire-on-peat export")
  terra::lapp(c(fireyear, peat_bin30, forest30),
              fun = function(fy, pb, fo) {
                fy[is.na(fy)] <- 0; pb[is.na(pb)] <- 0; fo[is.na(fo)] <- 0
                as.integer(fy >= y_lo_rec & fy <= y_hi_rec & pb == 1 & fo == 1)
              },
              filename = fire_peat_tif, overwrite = TRUE, wopt = wopt_int)
  sweep_temp()
}
register_output(fire_peat_tif)
rm(fire_rate_r, nonfire_rate_r, forest_count_r, forest_den_r); gc()
msg("GeoTIFF exports complete")
```

# Stratified validation sample

A design-based check on the fire attribution. Selection is uniform over the
qualifying 30 m pixels within each stratum, implemented as
probability-proportional-to-size selection of analysis cells followed by
uniform selection inside the chosen cell. This reads only small windows,
where the earlier approach would have returned hundreds of millions of cell
indices from a single call.

```{r validation-sample}
if (isTRUE(cfg$n_validation_per_stratum > 0)) {
gv_cells   <- terra::values(grid_counts, dataframe = TRUE)
pix_ha_vec <- as.vector(terra::values(terra::cellSize(template, unit = "ha"))) / npix

strata <- list(
  A_fire_on_peat  = pmax(gv_cells$n_fire_peat_rec, 0),
  B_loss_not_fire = pmax(gv_cells$n_nonfire_rec, 0),
  C_stable_forest = pmax(gv_cells$n_forest - gv_cells$n_loss_rec, 0)
)
strata <- lapply(strata, function(z) { z[is.na(z)] <- 0; z })

qualifies <- list(
  A_fire_on_peat = function(L, Fy, Fo, Pe)
    Fy >= y_lo_rec & Fy <= y_hi_rec & Fo == 1 & Pe == 1,
  B_loss_not_fire = function(L, Fy, Fo, Pe)
    L >= y_lo_rec & L <= y_hi_rec & Fo == 1 & !(Fy >= y_lo_rec & Fy <= y_hi_rec),
  C_stable_forest = function(L, Fy, Fo, Pe)
    Fo == 1 & !(L >= y_lo_rec & L <= y_hi_rec)
)

g_half <- cfg$grid_deg / 2

sample_stratum <- function(label, n_target, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  wts <- strata[[label]]
  if (sum(wts) == 0) { warning("no pixels in stratum ", label); return(NULL) }
  qual <- qualifies[[label]]
  pts <- list(); tries <- 0L
  while (length(pts) < n_target && tries < n_target * 10L) {
    tries <- tries + 1L
    ci <- sample.int(length(wts), 1L, prob = wts)
    xy <- terra::xyFromCell(template, ci)
    e  <- terra::ext(xy[1] - g_half, xy[1] + g_half, xy[2] - g_half, xy[2] + g_half)
    L  <- terra::values(terra::crop(lossyear, e))[, 1]
    Fy <- terra::values(terra::crop(fireyear, e))[, 1]
    Fo <- terra::values(terra::crop(forest30, e))[, 1]
    Pe <- terra::values(terra::crop(peat_bin30, e))[, 1]
    L[is.na(L)] <- 0; Fy[is.na(Fy)] <- 0; Fo[is.na(Fo)] <- 0; Pe[is.na(Pe)] <- 0
    win <- terra::crop(lossyear, e)
    ok <- which(qual(L, Fy, Fo, Pe))
    if (!length(ok)) next
    pick <- ok[sample.int(length(ok), 1L)]
    p_xy <- terra::xyFromCell(win, pick)
    pts[[length(pts) + 1L]] <- c(lon = p_xy[1], lat = p_xy[2])
    rm(L, Fy, Fo, Pe, win)
    if (length(pts) %% 25L == 0L) msg("stratum ", label, ": ", length(pts),
                                      " of ", n_target, " points")
  }
  if (!length(pts)) return(NULL)
  m <- do.call(rbind, pts)
  m <- m[!duplicated(m), , drop = FALSE]
  tibble::tibble(
    point_id = sprintf("%s_%03d", label, seq_len(nrow(m))),
    stratum = label,
    lon = m[, 1], lat = m[, 2],
    map_class = label,
    reference_class = NA_character_,
    imagery_source = NA_character_,
    note = NA_character_
  )
}

val <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sample_stratum("A_fire_on_peat",  cfg$n_validation_per_stratum, 101),
  sample_stratum("B_loss_not_fire", cfg$n_validation_per_stratum, 102),
  sample_stratum("C_stable_forest", cfg$n_validation_per_stratum, 103)
)

strat_areas <- tibble::tibble(
  stratum = names(strata),
  map_area_ha = vapply(strata, function(z) sum(z * pix_ha_vec, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(area_weight = map_area_ha / sum(map_area_ha))

write_table(val, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "validation_points_stratified.csv"))
write_table(strat_areas, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "validation_stratum_area_weights.csv"))
val_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(val, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
sf::write_sf(val_sf, file.path(cfg$out_dir, "validation_points_stratified.gpkg"),
             delete_dsn = TRUE)
register_output(file.path(cfg$out_dir, "validation_points_stratified.gpkg"))
knitr::kable(strat_areas, digits = 2)
rm(gv_cells, val_sf); gc()
} else {
  strat_areas <- NULL
  msg("Validation sampling disabled by configuration.")
}
```

```{r validation-accuracy}
labelled_path <- file.path(cfg$manual_dir, "validation_points_labelled.csv")
if (!exists("strat_areas") || is.null(strat_areas)) {
  msg("Validation sampling was disabled (cfg$n_validation_per_stratum = 0), ",
      "so no accuracy assessment is produced.")
} else if (file.exists(labelled_path)) {
  lab <- readr::read_csv(labelled_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(reference_class), reference_class != "skip_uncertain")

  cm <- table(map = lab$stratum, reference = lab$reference_class)
  print(cm)

  w <- strat_areas$area_weight[match(rownames(cm), strat_areas$stratum)]
  p_hat <- sweep(prop.table(cm, 1), 1, w, "*")

  acc <- tibble::tibble(
    overall_accuracy_area_adjusted = sum(diag(p_hat)),
    n_labelled = nrow(lab)
  )
  write_table(as.data.frame(cm), file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_S12_confusion_matrix.csv"))
  write_table(acc, file.path(cfg$tab_dir, "table_S13_area_adjusted_accuracy.csv"))
  knitr::kable(acc, digits = 4)
  rm(lab, cm, p_hat, acc); gc()
} else {
  msg("No labelled validation file at ", labelled_path,
      ". Interpret the exported points and return them under that name to ",
      "produce the confusion matrix and area-adjusted estimates.")
}
```

# Quality assurance summary

```{r qa-summary}
# minmax() gets the minimum and maximum in a single pass per layer, where
# two separate global() calls would read each raster twice.
mm <- function(r) {
  v <- try(terra::minmax(r, compute = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(v, "try-error")) c(NA_real_, NA_real_) else as.vector(v[, 1])
}
mm_loss <- mm(lossyear); mm_fire <- mm(fireyear); mm_peat <- mm(peat30)
mm_tc   <- if (have_treecover) mm(treecover) else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)

qa <- tibble::tibble(
  layer = c("lossyear", "fireyear", "peatclass_30m", "treecover2000", "grid_counts"),
  path = c(loss_path, fire_path, peat30_path,
           if (have_treecover) tc_path else NA_character_, grid_path),
  ncell = c(terra::ncell(lossyear), terra::ncell(fireyear), terra::ncell(peat30),
            if (have_treecover) terra::ncell(treecover) else NA_real_,
            terra::ncell(grid_counts)),
  min = c(mm_loss[1], mm_fire[1], mm_peat[1], mm_tc[1], NA_real_),
  max = c(mm_loss[2], mm_fire[2], mm_peat[2], mm_tc[2], NA_real_)
)
write_table(qa, file.path(cfg$diag_dir, "qa_raster_summary.csv"))
knitr::kable(qa)

consistency <- annual_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(ok_subset = fire_ha <= loss_ha + 1e-6,
                ok_peat_subset = fire_ha_peat <= loss_ha_peat + 1e-6)
if (!all(consistency$ok_subset) || !all(consistency$ok_peat_subset)) {
  bad <- consistency$year[!(consistency$ok_subset & consistency$ok_peat_subset)]
  stop("Internal consistency failed: fire-driven loss exceeds total loss in ",
       paste(bad, collapse = ", "), ". Delete grid_annual_counts.tif from ",
       cfg$proc_dir, " and rerun the counting stage.")
}
write_table(consistency, file.path(cfg$diag_dir, "internal_consistency_checks.csv"))
msg("Internal consistency checks passed")
```
